meta.name: TriliumNext Plugins — Official Registry
meta.author: ricolandia
meta.description: Personal plugin registry for TriliumNext Plugin Manager.

plugins.name: Weekly Planner
plugins.description: Simple Weekly planning board with Monday–Sunday columns.
plugins.author: ecodiv

plugins.name: Weekly Planner (Editor)
plugins.description: Weekly planning board with backlog and day columns. Original version by ricolandia.
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: Canvas Note Tools
plugins.description: Enhances TriliumNext's Excalidraw integration: create child notes directly from shapes, assign relation types per arrow, and batch-save all links at once.
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: Canvas Templater
plugins.description: A lightweight template system for Trilium Canvas. Insert complete visual frameworks directly into your Excalidraw canvases with a single click.
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: Canvas Templates For Production
plugins.description: A collection of Excalidraw templates for productivity, learning, and creativity. Ideal for use with the Canvas Template Loader.
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: FountainRenderer
plugins.description: Renders screenplay scripts written in Fountain directly inside TriliumNext. Supports scenes, action lines, dialogue, characters, and panel descriptions.
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: Longform Compiler
plugins.description: Aggregates a subtree of notes into a single compiled document. Useful for book manuscripts, academic articles, and any long-form writing split across multiple notes.
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: AI Chat (OpenRouter)
plugins.description: Inline AI chat widget powered by OpenRouter. Supports multiple models (GPT-4o, Claude, Mistral, etc.) with conversation history, configurable system prompt, and context from the current note.
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: Minimalist Pomodoro and Time Tracker
plugins.description: A monochromatic Pomodoro timer widget with per-note time tracking and automated report generation. Built with zero external dependencies.
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: Attribute Garbage Collector
plugins.description: Scans all notes in your TriliumNext database for broken relations, unused labels, rare attributes, and near-duplicate names. Preview and batch-delete them — deletions persist.
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: Shared Notes
plugins.description: Share notes between TriliumNext instances via invite strings.
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: Knowledge Debt
plugins.description: Track and manage knowledge gaps in your notes. Organize what you don't know yet.
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: Kanboard Integration
plugins.description: Integracao com Kanboard via API JSON-RPC. Sincroniza projetos, colunas e tarefas.
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: Word Counter
plugins.description: A compact right-pane panel showing word and character counts for the current note, alongside a daily progress bar.
plugins.author: ricolandia

plugins.name: Mastodon Sender
plugins.description: Compose and post toots directly from TriliumNext with visibility control, content warnings, and current note support.
plugins.author: ricolandia
